description: This file defines the class SugarWidgetSubPanelEditSecurityGroupUserButton, which extends SugarWidgetField to render a custom button for editing security group user relationships in the SugarCRM SubPanel. It contains methods to generate HTML for the button in different contexts within the UI.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelEditSecurityGroupUserButton
classes.description: A widget class for rendering an edit button for security group user relationships within a subpanel in SugarCRM. It extends SugarWidgetField and overrides methods to display the appropriate HTML link.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Returns a non-breaking space for the header cell in the subpanel column.

methods.name: displayDetail
methods.description: Returns the output of displayList, used for rendering the detail view of a row.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML link with an edit icon for the security group user relationship, depending on the layout context.
